set.body:
Scope

Distinguish models that share coefficients across concatenated runs, estimate run-specific coefficients, or fit runs separately and combine them by fixed effects. Reuse existing OLS/runwise engines rather than duplicating solvers.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The model plan exposes closed coefficient-scope alternatives with precise coefficient identity and hypothesis semantics.
- [ ] Per-run intercept/drift construction remains a design decision and is not conflated with task coefficient sharing.
- [ ] SharedAcrossRuns validates compatible structural effects while allowing explicit per-run acquisition grids/TRs.
- [ ] RunSpecific gives each coefficient a structural run scope and prevents accidental cross-run contrast alignment.
- [ ] SeparateRunsThenFixedEffects exposes per-run sufficient statistics, combination weights, effective df, and provenance.
- [ ] Fixed-effects combination is associative within tolerance and refuses incompatible estimands/fingerprints.
- [ ] Whitening and censor segmentation never cross run boundaries under any coefficient scope.
- [ ] Existing RunwiseLeastSquares behavior maps to the new semantics without hidden changes.
- [ ] Mixed-TR, missing-run-cell, and cross-run hypothesis tests pass on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: P2.6: make run coefficient scope an inspectable model semantic
